name: DuckDuckGo Browser
statusNote: Actively developed and updated across desktop and mobile platforms.

availability.cpuNotes: Windows support is documented for recent 64-bit releases; older 32-bit support is being retired.
availability.installMethod: Direct download or platform app store.

foundation.codeLicense: Free product with parts of the codebase published openly

telemetry.note: DuckDuckGo documents that it does not track searches or browsing history.

trackerBlocking.note: Third-party tracker blocking is enabled by default.

fingerprintingProtections.note: Multiple layers of fingerprinting protection are documented.

privacy.privateWindows: Protections are applied in ordinary tabs rather than reserved for a separate private mode, and browsing data can be cleared with one action.

vpnOrProxy.note: A device-wide VPN is included with the paid Privacy Pro subscription and managed inside the browser.

manifestV2.note: No third-party extension platform is documented.

manifestV3.note: No third-party extension platform is documented.

extensions.limitations: There is no third-party extension store by design; protections that other browsers delegate to add-ons are built in instead.

nativeContentBlocking.note: Ad, tracker, and cookie pop-up blocking are built in.

readerMode.note: No native reader view is documented.

sync.note: Sync & Backup pairs devices by QR code without an account and is end-to-end encrypted.

pwa.note: The desktop browser does not install sites as web apps.

iosEngine.note: Apple permits alternative engines in the EU and Japan under entitlement; the shipping iOS build renders with WebKit.

assistant.note: An optional private AI chat surface (Duck.ai) is documented.

summarization.note: Duck.ai can attach page content and summarise the open page.

aiSearch.note: Optional AI-assisted answers on DuckDuckGo search results are a first-party setting.

contentGeneration.note: Duck.ai documents drafting text, with image generation in current desktop builds.

modelChoice.note: Duck.ai offers a choice of models, with additional models for subscribers.

aiPrivacyControls.note: DuckDuckGo documents anonymised access and no training on conversations.

voiceMultimodal.note: Voice chat and image input are documented in current desktop builds of Duck.ai.

dataSaver.note: No documented data-saving or compression mode.

mobileExtensions.note: Extension support on mobile is not documented.

setAsDefault.note: Can be set as the default browser on Android and iOS.

downloadManager.note: A download manager is not documented.

biometricLock.note: Face ID, Touch ID, or the passcode gates passwords and autofill only; there is no app or private-tab lock.

backgroundMedia.note: Background or picture-in-picture playback is not documented.

webPush.note: Web push support is not documented.

sources.label: DuckDuckGo browser product and help pages
sources.note: Product scope, platform availability, and default protection claims.
